summary: Repaired the easy band to retain triangle-area calculation and subtraction. All nine checks and all three final batches pass, including 289 native grading checks. Imports and level coverage remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Calculate an enclosing triangle’s area, subtract the given quadrilateral area, and round the missing triangle’s area when required.
reasoning_steps: Identify the enclosing triangle and triangular notch.
Calculate triangle area from perpendicular sides or two sides and their included angle.
Round the final result and answer using the stated units.
invariants: Valid geometry and positive target area.
The supplied angle lies between the supplied sides.
The diagram supports the displayed subtraction.
Every band retains triangle-area calculation and subtraction.
permitted_variations: Side lengths, included angle and quadrilateral area.
Consistent vertex relabeling, rotation and units.
Both larger and smaller missing regions.
